req.title: Rate limit not enforced
req.statement: The system shall not throttle single-client request rates below 60/min.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should not throttle single-client request rates below 60 requests per minute. This implies that the system should handle at least 60 requests per minute without returning a 4xx error due to rate limiting. The tests are designed to verify this behavior by sending requests at different rates and checking the responses.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_positive
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with test data.
actions: Send 60 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: All requests should return an HTTP 2xx response.

tests.name: test_rate_limit_negative
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with test data.
actions: Send 61 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: At least one request should return an HTTP 4xx response due to rate limiting.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

try:
    responses = [client.get("/tasks/") for _ in range(61)]
    assert any(response.status_code == 429 for response in responses)
except Exception as e:
    assert False, f"Test failed with exception: {e}"

tests.name: test_rate_limit_boundary
preconditions: The system is running and accessible.
The database is pre-loaded with test data.
actions: Send 59 requests to the /tasks/ endpoint within one minute.
expected: All requests should return an HTTP 2xx response.
